Modules

Advanced Video Editing & Data Management

Learn cutting edge Video Editing with advanced techniques to manipulate your footage exactly the way you wanted. We’ll not only teach you techniques like pacing, speed ramping, graphics, a solid timeline flow, working on high end projects, BUT - You’ll also learn Industry standard Data Management which is essential to become a Pro Editor - All of this will be taught from Scratch, you don’t need any prior knowledge of Video Editing.

Motion Graphics & Animation

You’ll learn advanced Keyframing Techniques, along with in depth Masks and Roto-brushing in Fusion, all of the techniques taught here are standard in Hollywood, making your videos look 10X better than any other video on the Internet. This all will be taught in the easiest way possible making the learning process fun. By the end of it, you’d not only become a F*ucking Great Editor, but also an amazing Designer and Animator.

Sound Design & Audio

You’ll learn how to make the viewer FEEL YOUR VIDEO. As the saying goes in Editing Industry, 50% of your Video depends on how you treat Audio and Sound Effects. Every click, every sound, all of it will be guided to make your video viewer feel every frame of your video, BUT - we’ll also learn the most upto date techniques to make your audio sound as if it was recorded in a Professional High End Studio. All of these assets will be provided to you so you can practice exactly the way Saif is teaching you.

Advanced Color Correction & Grading

Dive into Hollywood Standard Node Based Color Grading panel. Color is essential to provoke emotion in a video. All the big hit movies/shows you ever watched were graded in Color Page of Resolve. You’ll learn exact flow of nodes, CST’s, masks, keying, printer lights etc in the most fun way possible making it not only easy, but SOO EASY that you might consider becoming a Fulltime Colorist (Yes that is a thing, and IT PAYS A LOT - We’ll talk about it more in Masterclass).

Client Acquisition - Proven Techniques & Platforms to Hunt Clients as a Video Editor

So you now know how to Edit banger videos. The next step is to now find clients and work to turn this passion into a Lucrative Full Time Career. This Module is specifically designed to take you through Multiple platforms in order to find clients, call it Instagram, LinkedIn or Youtube. I will show you my personal way to approach and hunt for clients along with live examples and screen recordings.

-Saif

Hi Janab, I’m Saif, you might’ve seen me on the internet talking about Video editing and Remote work. I started Video Editing back in 2019, Initially I did it for my own Youtube channel and passion projects, learning and trying new things along the way. I did my first Paid Editing project with a client from the UK. After that I started working with Clients from the USA. And in just these 5 years, I have worked on videos of industry leading companies in the United States, like FOUNDR, ClickFunnels and so many more...

Just because of Video Editing,

→ I have the Freedom to work from anywhere in the World. All I need is a Laptop and Internet connection.

→ I am earning in Dollars while working with International clients, that allows me to live a life the way I wanted while travelling the World.

→ I have been able to reach hundreds of thousands of people just from my own organic content that I edited on Instagram of Editing Skool

I literally used the same techniques that are taught in this masterclass and applied them on my own organic content through which we were able to cross 100k+ Followers in less than 6 months. So after spending almost 1 year, I have poured in all of that knowledge in The Editing Masterclass.

Video Editing changed my life, now let me help you to change yours.

Module 1-6

28 Classes

Time: 6hr 30mins

Data Management & Advanced Video Editing

The basis of any video editing project is sorting the data so it’s accessible after years of doing the project. It also keeps you organized and speeds up the editing process. After that we will start from the editing basics. Strong basics help you in the advanced and more complex video editing. By the end of this section, you’ll have strong basics and in depth control over video editing in general. You’ll know how to manipulate the footage according to the requirements.

Module 6-7

13 Classes

Time: 4hr 15min

Motion Graphics & Animation

This section of editing in general seems complex and complicated. In reality if you have strong basics, and get the hold of the concepts inside the classes, you’ll be animating and making motion graphics with no problem. This is the most exciting part of editing as well. We will also take a deep dive into Fusion, a node based VFX software integrated inside Davinci Resolve. We will make a complete effect inside Fusion and get you comfortable using it.

Module 7-8

1 Class

Time: 55 min

Sound Design & Audio

Sound and Audio itself accounts for 50% of the visual we see. You may have stunning visuals or outstanding editing, without good audio, nobody’s going to watch it. In this section we will dive into how to Design your audio using different types of sound effects that emphasize the visuals. Not only that, the music used in between, manipulation of Dialogues of the speaker so what the speaker is saying is audible and understood by the viewer with no effort.

Module 8-9

12 Classes

Time: 2hr 50 min

Advanced Color Correction & Grading

Colors in visuals are like music for eyes. Color Grading can set the mood of the footage, make it aesthetically pleasing and conveys the emotions visually. In this section we will cover the Color Page in Davinci Resolve, a Hollywood standard. You'll learn all the uses of nodes, qualifiers, and windows to target specific regions of the footage and achieve any desired look on your footage by using these tools to your advantage.

What EXACTLY will you Learn

21 Hr+

Content

70+

Lessons

Modules

Module 1-6

28 Classes

Time: 6hr 30mins

Advanced Video Editing & Data Management

Learn cutting edge Video Editing with advanced techniques to manipulate your footage exactly the way you wanted. We’ll not only teach you techniques like pacing, speed ramping, graphics, a solid timeline flow, working on high end projects, BUT - You’ll also learn Industry standard Data Management which is essential to become a Pro Editor - All of this will be taught from Scratch, you don’t need any prior knowledge of Video Editing.

Module 6-7

13 Classes

Time: 4hr 15min

Motion Graphics & Animation

You’ll learn advanced Keyframing Techniques, along with in depth Masks and Roto-brushing in Fusion, all of the techniques taught here are standard in Hollywood, making your videos look 10X better than any other video on the Internet. This all will be taught in the easiest way possible making the learning process fun. By the end of it, you’d not only become a F*ucking Great Editor, but also an amazing Designer and Animator.

Module 7-8

1 Class

Time: 55 min

Sound Design & Audio

You’ll learn how to make the viewer FEEL YOUR VIDEO. As the saying goes in Editing Industry, 50% of your Video depends on how you treat Audio and Sound Effects. Every click, every sound, all of it will be guided to make your video viewer feel every frame of your video, BUT - we’ll also learn the most upto date techniques to make your audio sound as if it was recorded in a Professional High End Studio. All of these assets will be provided to you so you can practice exactly the way Saif is teaching you.

Module 8-9

12 Classes

Time: 2hr 50 min

Advanced Color Correction & Grading

Dive into Hollywood Standard Node Based Color Grading panel. Color is essential to provoke emotion in a video. All the big hit movies/shows you ever watched were graded in Color Page of Resolve. You’ll learn exact flow of nodes, CST’s, masks, keying, printer lights etc in the most fun way possible making it not only easy, but SOO EASY that you might consider becoming a Fulltime Colorist (Yes that is a thing, and IT PAYS A LOT - We’ll talk about it more in Masterclass).

Module 10-11

12 Classes

Time: 1hr 28 min

Client Acquisition - Proven Techniques & Platforms to Hunt Clients as a Video Editor

So you now know how to Edit banger videos. The next step is to now find clients and work to turn this passion into a Lucrative Full Time Career. This Module is specifically designed to take you through Multiple platforms in order to find clients, call it Instagram, LinkedIn or Youtube. I will show you my personal way to approach and hunt for clients along with live examples and screen recordings.

I literally used the same techniques that are taught in this masterclass and applied them on my own organic content through which we were able to cross 100k+ Followers in less than 6 months. So after spending almost 1 year, I have poured in all of that knowledge in The Editing Masterclass.

Video Editing changed my life, now let me help you to change yours.
